message.content:
An editorial illustration on a magazine cover depicts four men on a steep, jagged cliff under a light blue sky. The rock face is dark brown and textured, glowing orange at its top edge. 

At the bottom right, a man in an orange short-sleeved shirt and dark pants hangs from a rope. Above him, three men in greyish-purple long-sleeved uniforms and dark pants are positioned on the cliffside. One man at the top right clings to the rock, holding a rope that descends. Another man hangs from a rope in the center, and a third man at the bottom left hangs from the same rope while gripping the cliff edge. All four men wear dark shoes and look downward with tense facial expressions.

The large white word "TEMPO" is across the top, with smaller black text below: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other Indonesian text includes "PARA PENYOKONG SAMBO", "5-11 SEPTEMBER 2022", "RP 50.000", a barcode, and several other phrases in black and white lettering against various backgrounds.
